source: Yahoo chart daily; provider adjusted-close total-return proxy. Raw quote, corporate actions and volume retained. Full history predates selection; revised corporate-action histories are not point-in-time vintages.
calendar: exchange_calendars XNYS 4.13.2; exact common daily grid, no fill or dropped bar. Exchange-local session dates.
target: Mean next five session squared arithmetic returns of fixed daily equal-weight nine-sector basket. Nonoverlapping five-target-session chunks within each split, no cross-boundary targets. First 126 returns warm-up; incomplete final chunks reported not scored. Not intraday RV or observed conditional variance.

risk_controls.fixed_correlation: Train 2010-2017 only; on data before forecast origin. Other estimates use observations completed by origin close.
risk_controls.selection: Lowest mean validation QLIKE among Sample/EWMA/LedoitWolf only selects strong reference; all controls retained. Tie by fixed model name. Never use historical/confirmation losses for selection.
risk_controls.zero_mean: All covariance forecasts use zero conditional-mean approximation. Sample estimates centered with ddof=1; LW sklearn centered MLE scaled-identity shrinkage; EWMA uncentered second moments normalized within chosen lookback.

state_calibration.offset: Selected strong-reference forecast v0; Gamma model fits Y/v0 with log link, training-only scaling. mu=v0*exp(b+beta*xReturn+gamma*xNetwork).
state_calibration.selection: Fit train; choose return alpha on validation then network alpha including exact off. Refit selected parameters on train+validation for historical and confirmation, with fixed coefficients thereafter. No post-test tuning.

primary_comparison.family: Historical test and 2026 confirmation, Holm across two. Secondary State vs selected strong, and all model-control contrasts exploratory.

bootstrap.description: Paired circular blocks of nonoverlapping five-session targets, about one month at primary length; approximate under dependence/nonstationarity. Daily PnL uses 20-session blocks and 5/63 sensitivity. No normality assumption and no asset-day pseudoreplication.

practical_gate: Research gate, not industry rule: >=5% QLIKE gain over matched baseline with approximate CI above zero in historical test; nonnegative confirmation gain and comparison with selected strong baseline disclosed. Must not be one-year-only. No gate can establish live trading utility here.

surrogate.operation: Independent within-calendar-year circular shifts of each sector standardized by trailing 63-session standard deviation; preserve each year's per-sector empirical standardized values, disrupt cross-sector alignment. Offsets at least20 and at most year_length-20. Whole-year and 63-session-standardized controls only descriptive, not randomization-test p-values.
surrogate.scope: Historical-test years and confirmation separately, not a true stationary independence null.

strategy_library.rebalance: Last trading session of each ISO week, signals from previous session close, execution at current session close. Positions first earn following session's total-return-index change. One full session execution delay.
strategy_library.positions: Fixed units of adjusted total-return price index between rebalances; target unit notional at rebalance, no profit compounding. PnL normalized to fixed reference capital. Independent research sleeves, no actual fills or borrow availability.
strategy_library.note: Declared hypothetical ETF momentum/reversal/defensive proxies, not replications of individual-stock academic factors. All six fixed recipes retained, no best-factor search. No value/quality claim without fundamentals.

allocation.rebalance: Same close and one-session signal delay as strategy library; use past completed net PnL increments only.
allocation.hrp: Single linkage on sqrt((1-corr)/2), quasi-diagonal leaf order, recursive bisection with inverse-variance cluster risk. Independently implemented existing baseline; no claim of a new allocator.
allocation.validation_reference: Lowest net PnL standard deviation among Equal/InverseVol/LW-MinVariance selects strong allocation comparator; return, drawdown, actual underlying gross exposure and turnover must all be shown.
allocation.netting: Allocate strategy sleeves, aggregate underlying total-return-index units before transaction/borrow costs, so offsetting positions are netted. No double charging sleeve and aggregate cost.
allocation.comparison: HRP vs selected strong allocation reference, historical and confirmation. All four retained; volatility reduction alone is not economic benefit if exposure/return also fall. Fixed-capital additive PnL, Sharpe descriptive zero-cash-return proxy, no CAGR claim.

pnl_diagnostic: Daily gross/net PnL increments used for dependence/allocation. Cumulative PnL correlations only a labelled warning contrast. Explain gross covariance via known holdings W Sigma W^T, separating diagonal overlap and off-diagonal co-movement algebraically, not causally.
science_limits: Observed return networks are not latent trader/causal/contagion graphs; n=9 cannot establish empirical thermodynamic criticality. Keep herding/percolation/criticality theory and simulation as course spine. Confirm period shares historical market context with prior crypto work; not independent of every earlier observation.
